title: Minestats
description: A mod designed to make statistics. Monitor your chests/tanks to know exactly how much your factories are producing/consuming.
body:
Minestats is a utility mod that lets players track and monitor the contents of any block-based inventory in the world. Whether you're automating a factory, managing a storage room, or trying to optimize item production, Minestats gives you real-time statistics about how much each block produces, consumes, or stores.

⭐ Features
🔍 Monitor any container block

Use the Recorder Item to register or unregister any block that contains an inventory, such as:

Chests / Trapped Chests / Barrels
Any other modded blocks that has an item inventory

Once registered, the block becomes a data source for the statistics system.

📊 Automatic item statistics

Every monitored block is scanned periodically, generating detailed stats such as:

Items produced per second
Items consumed per second

These stats let you understand exactly how your automation/factory is behaving. And you can easily see them by opening the Monitor Screen. For that, press the dedicated keybind (configurable in the Controls menu)





🧩 Useful for both technical and casual players

Minestats helps players managing complex automation or just people who loves stats and have something to prove.

You no longer have to guess if your farm is big enough for your factories or if you need to overpower it.

🧪 Development Status

This mod is currently in ALPHA.
Features, data formats, and gameplay behavior may change significantly in future versions. Breaking changes are expected (in the worst case you'll just lose previous data).



Also please if you have any suggestions or issue with the mod, feel free to either create an issue on the github or go in the discord
